structure: list pane beside a detail pane; selection drives the detail
whenItWins: people compare or work through many items in a row
cost: two scroll regions and selection state
mobileBehavior: list and detail become two screens with back navigation
a11yNotes: keep focus in the pane that changed; announce the selection
examplePatternSources: Material Design canonical layouts|Apple Human Interface Guidelines split views

structure: list page; each item opens its own full page
whenItWins: items are rich and read one at a time; shareable item URLs matter
mobileBehavior: native fit: one column, back returns to the list position
a11yNotes: restore scroll and focus on return
examplePatternSources: GOV.UK Design System|Shopify Polaris resource index

structure: ordered list with inline actions and bulk select
whenItWins: fast clearing of many small items
mobileBehavior: swipe or overflow menu per row; bulk select via long press
a11yNotes: every swipe action also reachable by button; confirm destructive bulk actions

structure: folders, item list and reading pane side by side
whenItWins: reading content in context of its stream
cost: needs a wide screen; complex state
mobileBehavior: collapses to list then reader
a11yNotes: landmarks per pane; keyboard shortcuts documented

structure: key numbers on top, then charts and lists in a grid
whenItWins: a quick status check across many measures
cost: risk of a wall of equal widgets
mobileBehavior: cards stack by priority; charts simplify
a11yNotes: every chart has a text summary or table

structure: one primary chart or table with filters and a side panel
whenItWins: one decision or investigation dominates the job
mobileBehavior: filters move into a sheet
a11yNotes: filter changes announce the result count

structure: one scrolling page grouped by headings with a jump list
whenItWins: few settings, mostly read and toggled
mobileBehavior: jump list becomes a select or top menu
a11yNotes: group labels are headings; toggles have visible labels
examplePatternSources: GOV.UK Design System|Apple Human Interface Guidelines

structure: category list on the side, one category per panel
whenItWins: many settings in distinct areas
mobileBehavior: categories list first, panel as a new screen
a11yNotes: current category marked for assistive tech

structure: each step asks one thing with a clear next action
whenItWins: unfamiliar or high-stakes input; low error tolerance
mobileBehavior: already phone-shaped
a11yNotes: error summary at the top; back keeps answers

structure: numbered steps with progress and a review step
whenItWins: a known sequence of grouped fields
cost: progress UI and validation per step
mobileBehavior: stepper collapses to "Step n of m"
a11yNotes: progress is text, not only colour
examplePatternSources: Material Design steppers|Carbon Design System progress indicator

structure: central canvas, tool rail, properties panel
whenItWins: creating or arranging visual content
mobileBehavior: panels become bottom sheets; tools in an overflow
a11yNotes: every tool reachable by keyboard; canvas has a text alternative

structure: reading-width document, contextual side panel for comments or properties
whenItWins: mostly text with occasional structure
mobileBehavior: panel opens as a full-screen sheet
a11yNotes: headings and landmarks in the document; announce saves

structure: query box, filter column, ranked result list
whenItWins: people refine toward one answer
mobileBehavior: filters in a sheet with a result count on the button
a11yNotes: result count announced after each change

structure: image-led cards in a grid with sort and filter chips
whenItWins: choice is visual (products, places, media)
cost: image weight; less text per item
mobileBehavior: two columns, sticky filter chip row
a11yNotes: cards have text names, not only images

structure: all sections on one page with a sticky summary
whenItWins: returning or simple purchases
cost: long page; validation in many places
mobileBehavior: summary collapses into a toggle at the top
a11yNotes: field errors linked from a summary

structure: choose, details, pay, confirm as separate steps
whenItWins: choices depend on earlier answers (dates, seats, rooms)
mobileBehavior: one step per screen with a persistent total
a11yNotes: time-limited holds warned and extendable

structure: identity header, then tabs or sections for activity and details
whenItWins: a person or entity with several kinds of content
mobileBehavior: header shrinks; tabs scroll horizontally
a11yNotes: tabs follow the tab pattern; header image has alt text

structure: short page: photo, role, key facts and contact actions
whenItWins: contact or trust is the whole job
mobileBehavior: already phone-shaped; call and message actions first
a11yNotes: contact actions are real links (tel:, mailto:)

structure: hero with one action, then benefits, proof and a closing action
whenItWins: one clear offer for cold visitors
cost: can feel generic; see the tell catalog
mobileBehavior: sections stack; action stays reachable
a11yNotes: one h1; action text says what happens

structure: chaptered narrative with full-screen moments
whenItWins: the offer needs feeling or explanation before the ask
mobileBehavior: chapters become short screens; heavy media replaced
a11yNotes: motion respects reduced-motion; content readable without it

structure: short intro, then a grid of work or offerings that open details
whenItWins: the work sells itself (venues, portfolios, menus, events)
mobileBehavior: one or two columns; filters as chips
a11yNotes: grid items have text labels

structure: person or product on one half, name, promise and the main action on the other
whenItWins: a face or an object carries trust (hosts, coaches, makers, single products)
cost: needs one strong portrait or product shot
mobileBehavior: stacks: image first, then name and action above the fold
a11yNotes: image has alt text; the action is not inside the image

structure: edge-to-edge photo or muted video with the title and action laid over it
whenItWins: atmosphere sells (events, venues, travel, hospitality)
cost: media weight; text needs a scrim to stay readable
mobileBehavior: a vertical crop or a still poster; title and action stay in the first screen
a11yNotes: video muted with controls or a still; contrast checked over the image; reduced motion respected

structure: the name or one short phrase set huge across the first screen, the image secondary or cut out in front
whenItWins: a personal brand or a bold, memorable name
cost: depends on a display face that covers every script; long names need care
mobileBehavior: fluid type that reflows rather than shrinks to a sliver; the image moves below
a11yNotes: the name is live text, not an image; no clipped diacritics at tight line height

structure: two to four plan columns with a highlighted choice and a feature table
whenItWins: few plans that differ by features
mobileBehavior: plans stack; table becomes per-plan lists
a11yNotes: highlight is not colour-only; table has headers

structure: inputs (size, date, options) produce a price or a request for quote
whenItWins: price depends on the job (events, services, usage)
mobileBehavior: one input group per screen
a11yNotes: live price changes announced politely

structure: short explanation, one primary action, an example or template
whenItWins: first use; the next step is obvious
mobileBehavior: same, action full width
a11yNotes: illustration is decorative or has alt text
examplePatternSources: Atlassian Design System empty states|Material Design

structure: shows realistic sample data the user can keep or clear
whenItWins: value is easier to see than to explain
mobileBehavior: same
a11yNotes: sample is clearly labelled as sample
